assertions.title: All default columns rendered with correct headers
test_names: all sortable columns show unsorted state
sortable headers have role button
assertions.notes: table-sort.spec.ts verifies 5 sortable columns (id, priority, title, status, issue_type) render with aria-sort and role=button. It does not verify presence of SELECT/BLOCKED/ASSIGNEE/REPO/UPDATED columns which the validation evidence cites as part of the 10-column default set.

assertions.title: Issue ID column renders correctly with issue.id
test_names: click ID header sorts ascending
Sort by priority column
assertions.notes: Both specs use getRowIds() which reads td[data-column="id"] cells and asserts exact issue ID values (aaa-001/mmm-003/zzz-002 and sort-001..sort-005). This confirms the ID column renders issue.id correctly.

assertions.title: Title column renders and is searchable/highlightable
test_names: click Title header sorts alphabetically ascending
click again sorts alphabetically descending
assertions.notes: table-sort.spec.ts verifies title cells render expected strings via getRowTitles() reading td[data-column="title"]. Search-filter highlighting behavior within the table is not exercised — filter.spec.ts and search-filter-journey.spec.ts do not assert highlight markup inside table cells.

assertions.title: Status column displays status badge with correct styling
test_names: click Status header sorts by status
assertions.notes: table-sort.spec.ts verifies status values sort correctly as strings (closed < in_progress < open) which implies the column renders. Badge styling (colored chip classes, formatted labels like 'In progress') is not asserted in the spec.

assertions.title: Priority column renders P0-P4 badge with color coding
test_names: Sort by priority column
assertions.notes: journey-table-sort-select.spec.ts exercises all 5 priority levels (P0-P4) via sort ordering with 5 issues. It does not assert P0-P4 badge text rendering or color-coding CSS classes on priority cells.

assertions.title: Type column renders issue type (Task, Bug, Feature, Epic)
test_names: click Type header sorts by issue type
assertions.notes: table-sort.spec.ts sorts by issue_type and verifies ordering bug < chore < task via row IDs. It does not verify the rendered type label text (capitalized Task/Bug/Feature/Epic) or type-specific icons.

assertions.title: Assignee column shows assignee name or dash for unassigned
assertions.notes: No spec reads td[data-column="assignee"] values or tests the dash fallback for unassigned rows. Mock issues in table-sort/journey-table-sort-select include assignee fields but assignee rendering is never asserted.

assertions.title: Updated column shows relative date
assertions.notes: No spec verifies td[data-column="updated_at"] rendering or relative-date formatting (e.g., '2 hours ago').

assertions.title: Null/empty field renders placeholder (dash or empty)
assertions.notes: No spec mocks issues with null/empty fields and asserts placeholder rendering in table cells.

assertions.title: Extremely long title truncates gracefully with ellipsis
assertions.notes: No spec uses long-string fixtures or asserts CSS truncation/ellipsis behavior on title cells.

assertions.title: Column header click cycles sort: asc → desc → none
test_names: click ID header sorts ascending
second click sorts descending
third click clears sort
aria-sort attribute updates correctly
assertions.notes: table-sort.spec.ts explicitly tests all three stages of the sort cycle with aria-sort attribute and sort indicator (↕/▲/▼) assertions.

assertions.title: Sort indicator visible only on currently sorted column
test_names: only one column shows sorted at a time
Sort by status column resets priority header
assertions.notes: Both specs verify the issue-table__header-cell--sorted class moves to the newly-clicked column and is removed from the previously sorted one.

assertions.title: Sorting null/empty values: sort to end (asc) or beginning (desc)
assertions.notes: No spec mocks null/empty sortable fields and asserts sort placement. All mock issues have fully populated fields.

assertions.title: String sort is case-insensitive
assertions.notes: No spec uses mixed-case fixtures to verify case-insensitive sort. table-sort.spec.ts title fixtures ('Alpha bug', 'Middle task', 'Zebra feature') are all capitalized.

assertions.title: Numeric sort on Priority works correctly
test_names: click Priority header sorts ascending (P0 first)
click again sorts descending (P4 first)
Sort by priority column
assertions.notes: Both specs verify numeric priority sort: table-sort uses P0/P2/P4 (3 rows) and journey uses all 5 levels P0→P4 ascending and descending. The order returned matches numeric (not lexicographic) comparison.

assertions.title: Sort state persists after filter/search change
assertions.notes: filter.spec.ts and search-filter-journey.spec.ts exercise table filtering but none assert that a previously applied sort remains applied after the filter changes. 'sort persists when switching columns' is about a different behavior (switching sort column, not filter).

assertions.title: Multi-sort not supported (single sort at a time)
test_names: only one column shows sorted at a time
sort persists when switching columns
Sort by status column resets priority header
assertions.notes: Specs confirm single-sort semantics: clicking a new header removes aria-sort and sorted-class from the previous header.

assertions.title: Sorting is stable — rows with equal values maintain original order
assertions.notes: No fixture has duplicate sort-key values across rows to verify stability. All mock rows use distinct priorities/statuses/titles.

assertions.title: Checkbox column visible when showCheckbox=true
test_names: Select issues via row checkboxes and verify bulk toolbar
assertions.notes: Uses page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Select issue sort-001' }) confirming per-row checkbox column exists and is accessible.

assertions.title: Individual row checkbox toggles row selection state
test_names: Select issues via row checkboxes and verify bulk toolbar
assertions.notes: Clicks checkboxes for sort-001 and sort-002 and asserts toBeChecked() on both. Selection count text updates accordingly.

assertions.title: Clicking row (non-checkbox) does not toggle selection
assertions.notes: issue-detail-panel.spec.ts Table View tests click on the row body and verify the panel opens, but do not assert that the row checkbox remains unchanged.

assertions.title: Selection count display shows number of selected rows
test_names: Select issues via row checkboxes and verify bulk toolbar
assertions.notes: Asserts bulk-action-toolbar visibility and selection-count text '1 selected' then '2 selected' as checkboxes are toggled.

assertions.title: Selection survives sort/filter changes
assertions.notes: No spec selects rows, applies a sort/filter, and re-verifies checkbox state. journey-table-sort-select interleaves sort tests before selection tests, not after.

assertions.title: Deselect-all clears all selected checkboxes
test_names: Clear selection via toolbar button
assertions.notes: Clicks bulk-action-clear testid and asserts toolbar disappears and both sort-001 and sort-002 checkboxes become not.toBeChecked().

assertions.title: Clicking a row opens issue detail panel
test_names: IssueDetailPanel - Table View > clicking table row opens panel
drag-drop status change persists / kanban to detail panel via table
assertions.notes: issue-detail-panel.spec.ts Table View describe block explicitly tests: navigate to table, click a tr row, assert panel data-state='open' and issue-id text. assembled-views.spec.ts also exercises table-row click → detail panel.

assertions.title: Row click passes issue data to onRowClick callback
test_names: IssueDetailPanel - Table View > clicking table row opens panel
assertions.notes: After clicking the table row for 'First Test Issue', the spec asserts page.getByTestId('issue-id') contains 'panel-test-1' — confirming the clicked row's issue object is propagated to the panel.

assertions.title: Keyboard navigation: Enter or Space on a row triggers click
test_names: Enter key on focused column header triggers sort
Space key on focused column header triggers sort
assertions.notes: Enter/Space are tested against column HEADERS (for sort) but never against table ROWS to trigger onRowClick and open the detail panel.

assertions.title: Row highlight shows visual feedback when selected
assertions.notes: No spec asserts a visual selected-state class (e.g., issue-table__row--selected) on checked rows.

assertions.title: Small list (< 100 rows) renders all rows statically
assertions.notes: No spec distinguishes static vs virtualized rendering at the <100 threshold.

assertions.title: Large list (> 100 rows) uses virtual scrolling
assertions.notes: No spec loads >100 rows or asserts virtualization (spacer rows, windowed DOM nodes).

assertions.title: Virtual scroll with 1000 issues maintains 60 fps
assertions.notes: Requires specialized performance testing (frame timing, CDP tracing); not achievable with standard Playwright assertions.

assertions.title: Virtualized row rendering uses spacer rows for scroll height
assertions.notes: No spec asserts presence of virtualizer spacer rows or measures scroll container height against expected total.

assertions.title: Row height is consistent and estimated correctly
assertions.notes: No spec measures row bounding boxes or virtualizer estimateSize accuracy.

assertions.title: Scrolling to bottom loads/shows all remaining rows
assertions.notes: No spec scrolls the table container and asserts final-row visibility.

assertions.title: Overscan buffer ensures smooth scroll without visible gaps
assertions.notes: No spec checks overscan count or asserts absence of visible gaps while scrolling.

assertions.title: New issue added via SSE appears as new row
assertions.notes: server-push.spec.ts tests SSE lifecycle against kanban view, not table. No spec pushes an SSE 'issue_created' event while on /view=table and asserts a new tr appears.

assertions.title: Existing issue updated via SSE updates row in place
assertions.notes: No spec emits 'issue_updated' SSE events while on the table view and verifies in-place cell updates.

assertions.title: Issue deleted via SSE removes row
assertions.notes: No spec emits 'issue_deleted' SSE events while on the table view and verifies the row disappears.

assertions.title: Live updates respect current sort order
assertions.notes: No spec applies a sort then pushes SSE updates and verifies new/updated rows are inserted in the correct sorted position.

assertions.title: Live updates don't clear user selection
assertions.notes: No spec selects rows, pushes SSE updates, and asserts checkbox state preserved.

assertions.title: SSE connection state displayed
assertions.notes: server-push.spec.ts covers generic SSE connection indicators but not within the table view context. The contract asks about connection status shown alongside the table.

assertions.title: SSE reconnect with exponential backoff
assertions.notes: server-push.spec.ts exercises reconnect generically; no table-specific test asserts the table view recovers from SSE disconnects.

assertions.title: SSE catch-up: events since last ID are replayed on reconnect
assertions.notes: server-push.spec.ts may test generic Last-Event-ID replay, but no table-view-specific test asserts that catch-up events update the rendered table.

assertions.title: Empty state message when no issues
test_names: sorting with empty table displays empty message
assertions.notes: Mocks /api/ready with empty data array and asserts page.getByTestId('issue-table-empty') is visible. Also verifies sort still works without errors.

assertions.title: Loading skeleton during initial data fetch
assertions.notes: skeleton.spec.ts covers kanban skeleton, not table. No spec delays /api/ready and asserts a table-skeleton testid.

assertions.title: Loading state persists until first data arrives
assertions.notes: No spec asserts loading state visibility is maintained until the first chunk of table data renders.

assertions.title: Sortable headers have aria-label for screen readers
test_names: aria-label describes sort state
assertions.notes: Asserts the aria-label includes '/currently sorted ascending/' and '/currently sorted descending/' after clicks, confirming screen-reader-friendly sort state.

assertions.title: Checkbox labels identify the row
test_names: Select issues via row checkboxes and verify bulk toolbar
assertions.notes: Uses getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Select issue sort-001' }) — the accessible name includes the issue ID, confirming labels identify their row.

assertions.title: Sortable headers are keyboard accessible
test_names: Enter key on focused column header triggers sort
Space key on focused column header triggers sort
Tab navigates between sortable headers
sortable headers have role button
assertions.notes: Covers Enter/Space activation, Tab traversal between sortable headers, and role=button attribute on headers.

assertions.title: Long assignee names truncate or wrap without breaking layout
assertions.notes: No spec uses long-string assignee fixtures or measures row layout/overflow.

assertions.title: Issue with all fields null/empty renders without errors
assertions.notes: No spec mocks an all-null-fields issue and verifies no render errors or console warnings.

assertions.title: Sorting with mixed data types (null and string)
assertions.notes: No spec mixes null and non-null sort keys to verify robust sort behavior.

assertions.title: Search term with regex special characters
assertions.notes: No spec types regex metacharacters (., *, ?, [, ]) into the search box and asserts the table does not throw or misbehave.

assertions.title: Rapidly toggling sort clicks does not cause race conditions
assertions.notes: No spec rapid-clicks a sort header and asserts final state is deterministic without intermediate visual glitches.

assertions.title: High-frequency SSE updates don't cause flickering
assertions.notes: No spec bursts SSE events against the table view and measures re-render count or DOM churn.

assertions.title: Issue created and immediately deleted via SSE
assertions.notes: No spec pushes a create-then-delete SSE sequence and asserts final row count/order in the table.

assertions.title: Sort of 1000 rows completes in <200ms
assertions.notes: Performance assertion; cannot be meaningfully verified via standard Playwright assertions. Needs specialized performance test (e.g., Vitest benchmark or Playwright CDP trace).

assertions.title: Sort is stable for equal keys
assertions.notes: No spec creates fixtures with duplicate sort-key values to observe stable ordering. Same gap as VAL-FE-TABLE-023 but from a performance/algorithmic angle.

assertions.title: Large dataset sort does not block user input
assertions.notes: Performance assertion; needs non-blocking-main-thread verification (e.g., interaction latency during sort) which standard Playwright tests cannot assert meaningfully.
